settings.label: About this product
settings.text: A cushiony concealer that lifts the look of dark circles without settling into fine lines. Light-to-medium cover that you can build with a tap.

settings.label: How to use
settings.text: Pat a small amount along the inner corner and under the eye with a ring finger. Press, do not rub, then add a second layer only where you need more.

settings.label: Pair with
settings.text: The color-correcting neutralizer cancels blue and purple tones first, so the concealer can be a lighter touch.

settings.quote: “The balm gives you the flush. This is what brightens the eyes.”

settings.label: Will it look heavy or cakey under my eyes?
settings.text: No. The cream is thin enough to stretch and moves with the skin; use less than you think.

settings.label: Is it gentle on sensitive skin?
settings.text: It is fragrance-free and formulated without common irritants, and it is safe for the delicate eye area.

settings.label: What exactly does a neutralizer do?
settings.text: It counteracts blue or purple tones with an opposite color, so your concealer can stay light.

settings.label: Do I still need concealer afterward?
settings.text: For many people, yes, but a thin layer is enough because the corrector has already done the heavy lifting.
